answer_1.quote: Text-to-SQL systems, which translate natural language questions into SQL queries, have become vital across various industries by democratizing data access and facilitating data-driven decisionmaking.

answer_2.quote: Exact Matching (EM) and Execution Accuracy (EX) were proposed to evaluate text-to-SQL systems in the Spider.

answer_3.quote: We propose FLEX (False-Less EXecution), a novel approach leveraging LLMs to emulate expert-level evaluation of SQL queries.

answer_4.quote: Three SQL experts with over three years of experience independently evaluated these queries for semantic correctness. Discrepancies were resolved through consensus.
answer_4.guideline: The interannotator agreement measured by Fleiss' kappa was 79.32, indicating strong agreement. We employed Cohen's kappa and accuracy score to measure the agreement between human experts and EX.
